children: RNS Number : 6862S  RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd  01 September 2026

RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd, the London Stock Exchange-listed investment company focused on identifying transformative assets with high growth potential across the life sciences sector, is pleased to share that its Interim Results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 will be published on 14 September 2026.

At 10:00 BST on 14 September, RTW Investments' Chief Investment Officer, Rod Wong, and Senior Director of Business & Corporate Development, Oliver Kenyon, will host a webinar via the London Stock Exchange Group's SparkLive platform. The webinar is open to research analysts and existing or potential shareholders. To register your attendance at the webinar, click here.

At 14:00 BST on 22 September, Rod Wong and Oliver Kenyon will host a live Q&A, also via the SparkLive platform. Those interested in attending the Q&A may request a registration link via biotechopportunities@rtwfunds.com. Questions may also be submitted during the live Q&A or in advance to the same address.
Jefferies International Limited - Joint Corporate Broker

is an investment fund focused on identifying transformative assets with high growth potential across the biopharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. Driven by a long-term approach to support innovative businesses, RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd invests in companies developing next-generation therapies and technologies that can significantly improve patients' lives. RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd is managed by RTW Investments, LP, a leading healthcare-focused entrepreneurial investment firm with deep scientific expertise and a strong track record of supporting companies developing life-changing therapies.
Visit the website at www.rtwbio.com for more information.
